parrafo_1.es: Beauty Bar Head Spa by Limor es un estudio dentro de Image Studios, en Delray Beach, especializado en head spa de lujo. Cada visita empieza con un scalp analysis bajo microscopio para ver exactamente que necesita tu cuero cabelludo.
parrafo_1.en: Beauty Bar Head Spa by Limor is a studio inside Image Studios, in Delray Beach, specialized in luxury head spa. Every visit starts with a microscope scalp analysis to see exactly what your scalp needs.

parrafo_2.es: Usamos productos profesionales Luseta y Pracaxi, y una silla de masaje de cuerpo completo para que la experiencia no se quede solo en el cabello.
parrafo_2.en: We use professional Luseta and Pracaxi products, and a full-body massage chair so the experience goes beyond just your hair.

Today I treated my daughter to a service. It was a beautiful suite, very calm and relaxing. The experience was phenomenal, very thorough in explaining the process.
